description: This file defines a Dagger module for dependency injection in a Kotlin-based Android project. It provides bindings for syncing and messaging components, including `SyncManager`, `SyncSubscriber`, and `FirebaseMessaging`.

classes.name: SyncModule
classes.description: An abstract Dagger module class that binds implementations for sync status monitor and subscriber, and provides a singleton instance of FirebaseMessaging.

methods.name: bindsSyncStatusMonitor
methods.description: Binds an implementation of `SyncManager` (`WorkManagerSyncManager`) to the interface for dependency injection.

methods.name: bindsSyncSubscriber
methods.description: Binds an implementation of `SyncSubscriber` (`FirebaseSyncSubscriber`) to the interface.

methods.name: provideFirebaseMessaging
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of `FirebaseMessaging` using `Firebase.messaging`.
